description: Observe page structure and element refs for click/fill/type. Scope with selector on complex pages. AI mode deduplicates delivered observations and supports snapshot IDs and diffs. Refs target elements in the latest captured scope; refresh after navigation or a stale-ref error.

baselineId.description: Diff against this delivered snapshot ID. A missing or incompatible baseline returns a full view.

depth.description: Limit tree depth (mode="ai" only). Use 10-14 on deep feed pages to shrink output.

diff.description: Return only the changed region vs your previous snapshot of this tab (mode="ai" only).

force.description: Return the full snapshot even if the page is unchanged since your last snapshot.

format.description: Only meaningful with mode="interactive": "json" = compact array.

intent.description: What you want to do on this page, in words (e.g. "open account settings"). mode="ai" only: the refs of THIS snapshot are ranked against it and the best one is named in a "Jev target:" line. Advisory — nothing is clicked, and no ref is invented.

maxChars.description: Cap snapshot text in characters, excluding brief metadata (default 30000). Truncates at complete lines.

mode.description: "ai" (default) = compact YAML with [ref=eN] element refs — pass ref to browser_click/fill/type to act on elements. "interactive" = flat list of clickable elements with selector hints. "full" = legacy accessibility tree. "landmarks" = structural overview.

selector.description: Scope snapshot to a specific element's subtree. Dramatically reduces output on complex pages.

sessionId.description: Browser session ID. If omitted, auto-selects the only open session.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab within the session. Auto-resolved from environment if omitted.

viewport.description: Drop off-screen nodes (legacy modes only; ignored for mode="ai" — use depth/selector instead).

name: browser_snapshot
